sourceExtent.usage: Local visual reference only; do not redistribute source imagery or tiles.

method: Reinspected a new original-resolution crop around preview pixels [960,600]-[1110,745], plus the existing museum crop. Only clearly visible roofs omitted from both previous sets are included.
usage: Authored numerical observation data only. Source imagery and tiles are local reference and must not be redistributed. OSM roads/buildings and authored museum collision clearances take priority.
